text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Coming in first place, it's Hishi Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I might've lost again, but that was fire!
You really
are somethin' else, Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm never gonna give up, though! Not for
the next
race, or the one after that, or
the one after that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A big round of applause rains down
around
Akebono to celebrate her
triumph.

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow, her power is just incredible!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text: For sure! Bono's races are the best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
I knew it. But of course I did. I've
seen this
sight so many times already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono dashes toward the
runners' tunnel
amid the audience's
thunderous cheers.
